about_the_game:
Shape a fertile landscape from humble camps into a thriving medieval realm, brimming over with life and filled with hope.

A keen ear and wise decisions are essential to building a prosperous kingdom. Become the leader your people need, shaping their districts and providing them with the means to thrive. But fret not, my Liege—you aren't on your own. Skilled companions will stand by your side, their fates entwined with your City Tales.

  • Organic cities: Forsake rigid grids and shape cities that grow naturally over time.

  • Swift, strategic economy: Balance resources and citizens' needs to nurture your city's prosperity.

  • A relaxing pace with challenges: Enjoy rewarding gameplay in a beautiful medieval world, where challenges emerge naturally as your city evolves.

  • 4. A Leader of the people: With companions whose skills develop under your guidance, build a city shaped by the needs and desires of its people.

Natural growth, organic path

Break free from chains of rigid design—craft living, breathing settlements with a unique district drafting tool. Your villagers' frequent pathways will carve organic, winding roads and shape an ever-evolving landscape of your city and farmlands.

The walks of life

Every district's needs and desires are shaped by its residents. Some of them will flock to the tavern, while others prefer the peace and quiet of a church. But in the end, each area will evolve based on your choices.

A Swift and Impactful Economy

Guide the pulse of a thriving economy. Manage resources wisely and make swift, strategic decisions to lay the foundation for your city that rises like a beacon of medieval progress.

Advisors by your side

Companions of wit and skill bring strength and knowledge to both your city's economy and story. Place them in charge of key production and watch them grow into their roles, unlocking bonuses for buildings and training future helpers to take their place.

A canvas full of tales

City Tales is graced with a gentle atmosphere and hand-painted vibrancy. It breathes warmth and wonder into every stone and timber. Discover how you'd like to flow with this land and paint your own story.

Whether you choose to optimize your production chains, pursue your personal goals or help others grow their skills, this Tale is fully yours to tell and your decisions will determine how your city unfolds. There are no wrong choices, my Liege. We are here to follow your lead.

City Tales is made with love by a small, passionate team. Join us on Discord and help us make the game even better!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: CPU Intel® Core™ i5-7600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5-13600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX3070 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: City Tales is a medieval city builder. With an organic building system, you're free to shape vast, living cities beyond the usual grid. Manage resources, plan vibrant districts in accordance with your citizens' needs, and build a thriving city you'll be proud of!
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
